paraphrase: OPEN analyst generalization of ST I q.7 a.1 co.: for every y, perfection r and z, if y has r limited by z, then y's having r is received in z. The source reading (STMT-ESSE-LIMITED-ONLY-THROUGH-RECEPTION) is restricted to esse, and its claim records why Aquinas restricts it; extending it to every perfection is a contested analyst bridge.
